title: Four teens accused of selling nude AI images of classmates
key_facts: Police in Lomas de Zamora reportedly raided homes of four teenagers, reportedly 15-year-old pupils at Colegio Modelo Lomas, on 9 Oct 2026.
They are accused of using AI to make fake nude images of female classmates from social media photos, sharing them and trying to sell them on adult-content sites.
An adult who allegedly used a credit card to pay for the AI tool is being examined; it is unclear whether the adult knew how it was used.
Families allege the school knew for about a month without telling parents; the allegations are not independently established.
The article lists similar cases in Argentina: Ituzaingo (last week), Buenos Aires university schools (July), Santa Fe (September).
quote_evidence: Police in Lomas de Zamora have reportedly raided the homes of four teenagers accused of using artificial intelligence (AI) to create and sell fake nude images of female classmates at a school in Argentina.
Around 50 girls are believed to have been affected, with the fake images reportedly involving pupils from the first to fifth years of secondary school.
why_it_matters_hint: Easy-to-use AI tools are being used to abuse schoolgirls in several Argentine schools.
notes: Allegations only; some parts attributed to Perfil newspaper. Minors involved are unnamed in the article.
